proof_body:
by
  intro N x hx
  rw [eq_div_iff hx]
  induction N with
  | zero => simp; ring_nf
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, mul_add, ← add_assoc, add_mul, ih]
    have h1 : Real.sin (((N + 1 : ℕ) + 1 / 2 : ℝ) * x) = Real.sin ((((N : ℝ) + 1) * x) + x / 2) := by
      push_cast; ring_nf
    have h2 : Real.sin (((N : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * x) = Real.sin ((((N : ℝ) + 1) * x) - x / 2) := by
      ring_nf
    rw [h1, h2, Real.sin_add, Real.sin_sub]
    ring
target_source: ∀ (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ), Real.sin (x / 2) ≠ 0 → 1 + 2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, Real.cos (((k : ℝ) + 1) * x) = Real.sin (((N : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * x) / Real.sin (x / 2)
